impact_assessment.managerial: A prediction API could support operations, but weak discrimination could waste intervention effort.
impact_assessment.risk: The evaluated candidate does not meet predictive or absolute economic gates.
impact_assessment.technical: FastAPI, Docker, CI, monitoring, MLflow, registry, and retraining components are available.

deployment.reason: The process model requires return to Business Understanding when business goals fail.
deployment.rollback_policy: A candidate never replaces the champion until all gates and tests pass.

utilization.continuous_training: Implemented but promotion remains gated by data, model, business, and test checks.
utilization.domain_user_interface: FastAPI Swagger UI at /docs for prototype demonstration
utilization.maintenance: Versioned retraining checks data hash, model age, observed performance, and manual triggers.
utilization.support: Validation errors and runtime prediction events are counted and logged.
